# Happy Hour Flower

> Find your happy place - FAST. Happy Hour Flower is a local discovery app for happy hour deals, drink and food specials, events and food trucks, starting in Greenville, SC. Consumers browse verified specials by neighborhood, day and time; venue owners claim and manage their listings, post deals and reach nearby fans.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://happyhourflower.com/): Overview of the app for consumers and venues
- [For consumers](https://happyhourflower.com/site/consumers): How people find happy hours and specials near them
- [For venues](https://happyhourflower.com/site/venues): How bars and restaurants promote their happy hours
- [List your happy hour](https://happyhourflower.com/site/venues/list-your-happy-hour): Add or claim a venue listing
- [Happy Hour Flower vs Yelp and Google Maps](https://happyhourflower.com/site/happy-hour-flower-vs-yelp-google-maps): Comparison with other discovery apps
- [Greenville neighborhoods](https://happyhourflower.com/greenville-neighborhoods): Greenville, SC areas covered

## Pricing
